label: flight-2026-09-23
app: hand flown by the students with the aircraft's own app, timed shots every 3 s
pattern: hand flown by the students in a strong wind, tracks back and forth across the field and along its edges at 3 s intervals rather than the planned strips; 337 photographs above 70 m, of which 85 were kept by a spatial thinning (at least 14 m apart, 6 m near the pinned window), see 80m_selection_rule.txt beside the photographs
people_note: checked 2026-09-29 by the instructor on a contact sheet of the 85 photographs: figures on the lawn and the paths are a few pixels tall at 2.8 cm, no face or plate is resolvable; the kit ships downsized photographs and the products only

selection.source: drone-01, the first flight of 23 September (15:06 to 15:25 local), photographs above 70 m
selection.rule: at least 14 m from every kept photograph, or 6 m within 80 m of the pinned window's centre
